verdict.rationale: Granola documents some first-party many-item actions. Chat can query all meetings or a whole folder at once, a CSV export covers every note, and notes added to folders sync automatically to HubSpot. There is no evidence of true bulk mutations such as multi-select edit, move, delete or re-templating. The API's list endpoint and workspace keys are only building blocks and are not credited. Missing for 10: bulk edit/move/delete/re-tag of many notes, documented batch API operations, independent or hands-on corroboration of bulk workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once

citations.quote: You can use Chat from your home screen to query all of your meetings, on a single meeting, or in any other set of meetings such as a folder
The CSV includes the title, note summary, transcript, and other basic details for each note.
You can set up Granola to automatically save any notes that are added to Granola folders to the relevant contacts, companies, or deals on HubSpot.
